title: Tropical island gateways & global night lighting! MSFS 2024 marketplace breakdown
description:
Looking to transform your nocturnal arrivals and high-altitude cruise across the globe? Dream Scenery has rolled out their "Night Enhanced" 2024 Exclusive Editions, overhauling highway streetlights, urban grids, and suburban glow across five key metropolitan centers:

Santiago, Chile

Johannesburg, South Africa

Manchester, United Kingdom

Quebec City, Canada

Fresno, California

Which of these new marketplace additions are you flying into first? Flying island-hopping jet routes into Bohol-Panglao, flying circuits around Borkenberge, or testing out the overhauled nocturnal road networks across the globe? Let us know in the comments below!
